records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md#why-you-would-want-it
records.summary: Quipu stores governed RDF knowledge locally and exposes the same knowledge engine to applications, command-line clients and agent tools.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md#share-knowledge-between-stores
records.summary: Repository pendants transfer source-bound knowledge between stores through explicit quarantine and promotion, keeping transport separate from receiver authority.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/src%2Fmain.rs
records.summary: The native command-line entrypoint parses local query, share, import, validation and server operations; command discovery does not authorize a live mutation.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/src%2Flib.rs
records.summary: The Rust library exposes the embedded graph engine used by native clients and repository integrations.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md#wire-it-into-your-agent
records.summary: The documented agent integration uses the native MCP entrypoint or an explicitly configured HTTP service; credentials remain deployment-owned.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md#share-knowledge-between-stores
records.summary: Imported knowledge stays staged until explicit promotion. Bundled shapes and source evidence are not automatic receiver authority.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md#first-success-in-three-commands
records.summary: Start with the documented local first-success commands, then validate behavior on your own source data.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md#before-you-start
records.summary: Read the feature, model and operating constraints before selecting a deployment or graph mutation path.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/scripts%2Fbuild-repository-share.sh
records.summary: The legacy trusted-host repository builder invokes the Bobbin indexer and Quipu share and quarantine checks. Private publication policy remains outside the public artifact.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md#on-your-own-data
records.summary: After a local first success, follow the documented source-data import path; public examples are not production admission.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/README.md#run-it-anywhere
records.summary: The native server exposes REST, MCP at /mcp and a web interface over the same graph engine. Remote deployment and write credentials are separately configured.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/src%2Fconfig.rs
records.summary: Configuration resolves command flags, project and global TOML files before built-in defaults. Graph-label floors are not read confidentiality controls.
